title: fix(fields,plugin-form,i18n): the line-items grid's required-cell text and the master-detail form's config hints read the locale packs (objectui#11160)
body:
Fixes #11160
Clause-②: no

## What

Under a zh session two parts of the line-items family were still English, measured on the card in the same render as translated text beside them:

- `GridField` named a required, empty cell as the column label followed by ` is required` (`Qty is required` next to the grid's `添加行`).
- `MasterDetailForm` showed three English configuration hints for a collection it could not resolve (`This collection has no child object configured…` under the heading `明细行`).

All six sites now read the locale packs. Only defaults move: the authored column label, and the authored child and parent object names, render as written. English output is byte-identical to the literals it replaces, with and without an i18n provider (reverse verification below).

## Where each string goes

| Site | Key | |
|---|---|---|
| `GridField` plain cell `title` | `validation.required` | reused; `{{field}}` is the column label (`c.label`, else `c.name`) |
| `GridField` lookup cell `error` | `validation.required` | the same expression |
| `GridField` file cell `error` | `validation.required` | the same expression |
| `MasterDetailForm` `md-detail-no-child-object` | `form.masterDetail.noChildObject` | new, `{{property}}` |
| `MasterDetailForm` `md-detail-schema-unavailable` | `form.masterDetail.schemaUnavailable` | new, `{{object}}` |
| `MasterDetailForm` `md-detail-no-relationship-field` | `form.masterDetail.noRelationshipField` | new, `{{object}}` / `{{parent}}` / `{{property}}` |

The three new keys are in all ten packs.

## How

- **Grid: one expression for the three sites.** All three sit inside the `GridField` component body, including the `renderCellInput` closure, so one closure `requiredCellText(c)` beside the other chrome labels reads `t('validation.required', { field: c.label || c.name, defaultValue: '{{field}} is required' })`. No new key and no third copy of the template. The inline default equals the `en` value; `check:i18n-keys` holds it there (positive control below).
- **Hints: the `{{property}}` split, generalised to several holes.** A local helper `withCodeHoles(sentence, holes)` in `MasterDetailForm.tsx` takes the pack sentence asked for with every hole filled by itself, splits it on the named holes and renders each hole as a code element holding its value. It finds holes by name, so it does not depend on the order a locale puts them in. The property names (`childObject`, `relationshipField`) are fixed values; the object names are the authored `childObject` and the parent `objectName`, exactly as before. `LineItemsPanel`'s `form.lineItems.noChildObject` split (PR objectui#11159) is the one-hole form of the same move. Measured with three holes: under a provider (the zh and en pins) and with none (the `.no-provider` pins).
- **Rows** are in `formChrome.ts`, equal to the `en` pack (`check:i18n-keys` compares them; positive control below).
- **Key placement.** The triage asked for the no-`childObject` hint to get its own key "beside" `form.lineItems.noChildObject`. It is `form.masterDetail.noChildObject`: the same leaf name, under the master-detail form's own chrome namespace, where the other two hints sit too. The en sentences stay distinct ("collection" / "panel").
- **Reuse search** for the other two hints, over `en.ts`: `schema`, `schema of`, `Could not load`, `couldn't load`, `relationship`, `links to`, `references the parent`, `no columns`, `master_detail`, `childObject`, `child object`, `unavailable`, `readable`, `reload`. The nearest candidate is `excelImport.schemaReadFailed` (`Could not read the object schema.`). It names no object, states no consequence and gives no remedy, so reusing it would have changed the English. Nothing carries the relationship hint's meaning. Both got new keys.
- **Translations.** `lookup` and `master_detail` are field type names and stay as written in every pack. No de value quotes a span, so the de `„…“` census does not move.

## Tests

New pins, 15 tests in 4 files:

- `packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.requiredCell.i18n-11160.test.tsx` (6). zh: the plain cell's `title` reads `Qty不能为空`. The lookup and file cells are handed `Product不能为空` and `Receipt不能为空` as their `error`, and their `title` says the same. No invalid cell keeps ` is required`. CONTROL zh: an authored zh label fills the hole as written (`数量不能为空`), and a column with no label falls back to its name. CONTROL en provider: all three sites, byte for byte. The lookup and file cells read `error` only for `aria-invalid` today, so the text they are handed is observed at the prop: the test wraps each module and records the `error` before rendering the real component.
- `GridField.requiredCell.i18n-11160.no-provider.test.tsx` (1): English at all three sites with no provider mounted.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.configHints.i18n-11160.test.tsx` (5). zh, one per hint: the full text, and the text of each code element in order (`childObject`; `po_line`; `po_line`, `purchase_order`, `relationshipField`). One ja case: a hole that opens the sentence still renders as code. CONTROL en provider: the three hints byte for byte.
- `MasterDetailForm.configHints.i18n-11160.no-provider.test.tsx` (3): the three English hints byte for byte, with the same code elements.

Existing pins that read these strings (`MasterDetailForm.detailChildObjectDecline.test.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.detailDeriveFailure.test.tsx`, the `line-items-invalid-*` cases in `GridField.test.tsx`) query by test id and `textContent`. English is byte-equal, so they stay green. **Moved pins: none.**

**Reverse verification**, with the fix committed at `c6ada4079`: `GridField.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and `formChrome.ts` were checked out from the base `a8c550938`, keeping the packs and the pins, with a trap to restore them. The swap was confirmed on disk: `requiredCellText` in the grid went from 4 to 0, the English literal came back 3 times, `withCodeHoles` in the form went to 0, the no-`childObject` literal came back once, and the `form.masterDetail.noChildObject` row in `formChrome.ts` went to 0. Over the four pin files the result was **9 failed / 6 passed (15)**, the predicted count and direction:

- red: every zh case, the zh label/name CONTROL and the ja case;
- green: both en-provider CONTROLs and both `.no-provider` files. The old literals produce exactly the English the new code produces.

After the restore, `git diff HEAD` was empty and all three blob hashes matched HEAD.

**Gate positive controls** (`ablation-replace`, anchor hit on disk, restored to the HEAD blob): with `is required` changed to `is requiredX` in the grid's inline default, `check:i18n-keys` exits 1 with `[default-value-drift] validation.required` on `GridField.tsx`. With one word changed in the `form.masterDetail.noRelationshipField` row, it exits 1 with `[factory-default-drift]` on `formChrome.ts`.

**Runs at `9337738d7`** (declared narrowing: package-scoped, not the repo farm; heavy runs through the shared verify lock):

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx`: **75 files passed; 1231 passed, 13 skipped** (includes the de quote-pairing census and all-locales key parity).
- `packages/plugin-form/`: **153 files passed; 1771 passed, 1 skipped**.
- `packages/fields/src/widgets/`: **107 files passed; 966 passed**.
- The rest of `packages/fields/src` (`__tests__/` plus the 9 top-level test files): **119 passed, 1 skipped (120) files; 2559 passed, 7 skipped**.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-form^...' --concurrency=2`: 11/11 tasks. Then `pnpm --filter` `type-check` for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-form`: all exit 0, zero `error TS`. Both packages' `tsconfig.test.json` list the new test files (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `pnpm exec eslint --format json` on the 17 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: exit 0, 0 errors, 50 warnings, **0 on a changed line**. The 17-file count is read from the JSON output. `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- All exit 0: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (0 en values changed, 3 keys added), `check-changeset-presence`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:self-import`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`. `check:i18n-dead-keys` is report-only and lists none of the new or reused keys.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-locale-catalogues`. Reason: `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, it reads a built console bundle (`apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`). The console build and the eager-closure byte budget are CI's (Bundle Analysis).

## `check:changeset-claims`: two pending changesets name files this diff touches

Both paragraphs were read, and both are still true:

- `.changeset/6625-retire-fieldmeta-decimals.md` names `GridField.tsx` for its `.scale` positive control. That file has 4 `.scale` reads at the base and 4 at the head.
- `.changeset/6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md` names `en.ts` for the `console.nav` strings. This diff adds keys under `form.masterDetail` only.

## Acceptance notes

- `LookupField` and `FileCell` read their `error` only as a boolean, for `aria-invalid` on their focusable control. `FileCell`'s own doc says the message text stays with the cell's `title`. So the translated text they are now handed is not displayed today. The pins observe it at the prop.
- `MasterDetailForm` still has one English sentence: the error `submitViaBatch` throws for a second submit while a save is in flight (`This save was not sent: another save of this form was still in progress.`). Whether it reaches the screen was not measured (it goes to `ObjectForm`'s error path and the host's `onError`). Noted here, not filed; per the triage, a later English site in these two files goes to a fresh card.
- Draft PR objectui#11086 edits `GridField.tsx` between the imports and `currencyAdornment`. This diff's grid hunks are the helper beside the row-action labels and the three sites, disjoint from those.
